name: How long does an exterior paint consultation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an exterior paint consultation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior paint consultation can vary depending on the size and complexity of your home, as well as the extent of any pre-existing issues. Generally, a consultation can take anywhere from 30 minutes to 1.5 hours. During this time, our consultant will thoroughly inspect your property and discuss all your concerns, providing a detailed overview of the potential project scope and timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: An exterior paint consultation usually takes 30 minutes to 1.5 hours, depending on your home's size and complexity. This allows for a thorough inspection and detailed discussion of the project scope.
